name: Otogari Adonis
source:
A young idol that came to Japan from the Middle East. Being kind in nature, Adonis hates violence and is eager to protect the weak. His singing voice is gentle and as if capable of embracing everything, along with the powerful yet tender performances.

Adonis is a member of UNDEAD at Rhythm Link.

[From in-game profile]
